verdict.rationale: The documented `--convert-to` CLI shows Word documents batch-converting to PDF via `writer_pdf_Export`, and the filter list includes Office Open XML Word (docx), Excel (xlsm) and PowerPoint (pptx) filters for converting between formats. A community user independently confirms running it headless in Docker to generate PDFs and normalize document formats. Some users report MS Office compatibility is weaker than OnlyOffice's, especially for Excel-specific files, but this is a fidelity concern rather than a failure to convert. Missing for 10: hands-on evidence of conversion fidelity for complex Excel/PowerPoint files, explicit documented examples of xlsx/pptx-to-PDF conversion.
